# Third-party code bundled with Ick Check

These files are copied unchanged from their published packages so the app works without loading code from other sites.

| Folder | Package | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `barcode/ponyfill.js` | barcode-detector | 3.2.3 | MIT (see `barcode/LICENSE-barcode-detector`) |
| `barcode/zxing_reader.wasm` | zxing-wasm | 3.1.6 | MIT (see `barcode/LICENSE-zxing-wasm`) |
| `tesseract/tesseract.min.js`, `tesseract/worker.min.js` | tesseract.js | 7.0.0 | Apache-2.0 (see `tesseract/LICENSE-tesseract.js.md`) |
| `tesseract/core/*` | tesseract.js-core | 7.0.0 | Apache-2.0 (see `tesseract/LICENSE-tesseract.js-core`) |
| `tesseract/lang/eng.traineddata.gz` | @tesseract.js-data/eng (tessdata 4.0.0_best_int) | 1.0.0 | Apache-2.0 |

The copyright notice in the repository README covers Ick Check's own code only, not these files.
